svg.text: Delocalisation of σ(C–H) electrons of an α-carbon into an adjacent empty p orbital or π bond
overlap lowers energy → positive charge is spread over the CH
No-bond resonance structures (one per α C–H)
σ electrons shift into the π bond, giving a partial C=C character
evidence: C–C of propene 150 pm (< 154 pm), μ = 0.36 D (CH
Stability of carbocations tracks the number of α-hydrogens (hyperconjugating C–H bonds)
more α-H → more hyperconjugation → more stable cation / more stable (more substituted) alkene
